rapid_exit_policy: Existing live-identity observation is fail-closed. If helper exits before that observation, its actual waited exit is retained as failure; no retry or success substitution.
verified: Already-exited helper identity failure performs actual wait and writes failed receipt, even exit code zero.
Live child observation failure performs terminate followed by actual wait.
Terminate timeout escalates to kill followed by actual wait, preserving failure and recursive drain pending.
Runtime deadline uses same kill/wait sequence.
If final kill wait itself fails, no success receipt is emitted; native exception exits nonzero and root must complete original recursive cgroup drain.
Required evidence rejects missing event, failed event, missing actual wait, CPU backend or wrong consumed library path.
